name: Jira
listCmd: curl -s -u "$JIRA_EMAIL:$JIRA_API_TOKEN" -G "https://YOUR-SITE.atlassian.net/rest/api/3/search/jql" --data-urlencode "jql=assignee = currentUser() AND statusCategory != Done ORDER BY updated DESC" --data-urlencode "fields=summary,status,description" --data-urlencode "maxResults=100"
